Backward-compat is intact.

POST /setup-progress endpoint correctly validates the `sections` whitelist (basics/cap/divisions/schedule/playoffs/draft/trades) returning 400 on unknown — verified. Auth gating returns 401/403 without commissioner token — verified.

Mark-winner auto-create logic in ops_console.py inserts a fresh playoff_matchup row with auto_created=true when target_idx is past existing DB rows. Subsequent mark-winner calls correctly update the SAME row (not duplicate) — verified by inspecting DB count (7 total rows after both QF#2 and QF#3 marked, only 1 auto_created). Frontend correctly hides mark-winner buttons until both home_team_id AND away_team_id are populated AND matchup_id is real (not synthetic) — verified.

Minor observation: the new SF#1 auto_created row inherits no `home_team_tbd`/`away_team_tbd` flags (vs the pre-seeded SF#0 row which has home_team_tbd=true). Not a bug since real team_ids are populated immediately, but for consistency the auto-create could optionally set tbd=false explicitly. Not blocking.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 RCA: `_compute_health_score` previously inferred section completion from default field values (e.g., playoff_teams=6 defaulted complete=true, salary_cap_enabled=false defaulted complete=true) producing 100% on brand-new leagues. Fix: added explicit `setup_progress: {<key>: true}` gating map stamped by SetupWizard.jsx per-step save handlers via new POST /leagues/{id}/setup-progress endpoint. Backward-compat: legacy leagues with setup_wizard_complete=true bypass the new gate and keep data-inference fallback. Bug 2 RCA: 8-team brackets only have 2 DB SF rows but the synthesizer renders 2 (SF#0 from DB, SF#1 in-memory only when DB is sparse). mark-winner endpoint computed target_idx=1 for QF#2 winners and looked up the SF#1 row in DB — finding none, it silently no-op'd. Fix: when target row missing, insert a fresh playoff_matchups doc with auto_created=true, bracket_round=next, home_team_id=winner. Subsequent mark-winner on QF#3 finds the auto_created row and fills away_team_id. Verified in DB and frontend.
